Title: Hindi selected but the home page hero and language card stay in English
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open the home page 2) Set language to Hindi in the header 3) Observe the hero, the badge and the 'Select Your Native Language' card
Expected: Every visible string renders in Hindi
Actual: Header and footer translate; the hero heading, sub-heading, badge and the whole language card stay English
Root Cause / Fix: CONFIRMED in current main: src/components/home/HeroSection.tsx has no useTranslation at all - every string is hardcoded. src/components/home/LanguageSection.tsx likewise. Fix: route both through t() and add keys to en + hi.

Title: Selecting Hindi in the 'Select Your Native Language' dropdown does not change the app
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Open the home page 2) Open the native-language dropdown 3) Choose Hindi 4) Press Continue
Expected: The app switches to Hindi immediately and the choice persists
Actual: Nothing changes; the app stays English. The dropdown also offers 10 languages when only English and Hindi exist
Root Cause / Fix: CONFIRMED: src/components/home/LanguageSection.tsx:44 only calls localStorage.setItem('selectedLanguage',...) - a key i18next never reads - and never calls i18n.changeLanguage(). NOTE: this is the SAME bug fixed on /register on 2026-07-12; that sweep missed this component. Not a regression - an incomplete fix. Correct pattern already exists at src/app/register/page.tsx:28-47 (useLanguagePreference, en/hi only).

Title: Last registration step asks for the mobile number and sends the user back to step 2
Steps to Reproduce: 1) Register as a seeker through to the final step 2) Refresh, or return to the tab later 3) Observe
Expected: Registration progress survives a page reload
Actual: The user is bounced back to the phone step and must start again
Root Cause / Fix: CONFIRMED: the verify-email guard router.replace('/register/phone') fires when the in-memory context is empty. Registration state is deliberately React context, never localStorage, so a plaintext password is never persisted - hence any refresh restarts the flow. Fix (in the rework): persist only NON-SECRET progress (phone, email, verified flags, step) to sessionStorage; the password stays in memory only.

Title: Footer 'For Employers' links open Login focused on the Job Seeker tab
Steps to Reproduce: 1) While logged out, click Post a Job / Find Workers / Pricing in the footer
Expected: Login opens with the Employer tab selected
Actual: Login opens on the Job Seeker tab, so an employer signs in on the wrong role tab
Root Cause / Fix: CONFIRMED: those three footer links point at protected employer routes, which redirect to /login; no role hint survives the redirect and the page defaults to the seeker tab. Fix: carry a role hint through the redirect - it must still pass through lib/safeRedirect.ts (an open redirect was already fixed on this path).
